question: In 1986, an operation had to be conducted against terrorists in the Golden Temple. What was the name of this operation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Operation Black Thunder.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Black Thunder** was conducted in **May 1986** by the Indian Army to flush out terrorists who had taken control of the **Golden Temple** in **Amritsar, India.**
 
• The operation lasted for **two days** and resulted in the deaths of over **80 terrorists **and **12 soldiers.**
 
• The operation was controversial as it took place in a **holy shrine** and resulted in **civilian casualties.**
 
• The operation was a major success for the Indian government as it helped to restore law and order in the region and weaken the **Khalistan movement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Operation Lightning Thunder** was a joint military operation conducted by the** United States and Uganda** in **2008.**

 
 
• It was against the **Lord's Resistance Army** (LRA) in Uganda.
 
 
 
• **Operation Thunder **was a joint military exercise conducted by the** United States and South Korea** in **2013.**
 
 
• It was done to improve their** joint military capabilities.**
